news.title: Moved to new domains
news.text:
The user-friendly Atomic Shop now has its own domain. The domain was kindly provided, while I took care of the setup, which took a few days, but is now complete.

New URLs:
Database Browser: db.atomicshop.fyi
User-friendly Atomicshop: uf.atomicshop.fyi

Old links should automatically redirect or update themselves for the transition time.
